caption: The drawing features three spherical objects arranged in a triangular formation on a plain background. The sphere in the upper left is rendered in shades of gray with swirling patterns of alternating dark and light tones radiating from a small central top point. To the right, an adjacent sphere of similar size displays swirling patterns as well, but in a combination of red, gray, and white, with the patterns also originating from a small central point at the top. Below these two spheres, a smaller one is depicted, featuring similar swirling patterns in gray tones, again beginning from a central point at the top. The overall drawing is on a beige background, and includes a notation “¾ size” and the signature “P. Ward” at the lower right corner.
title: Witch Ball
